meta_description: House front wall tiles for Pakistan: stone and brick elevation ideas, cladding tiles, fixing, drainage and colour tips, plus free samples from Pak Clay.
answer_box: House front wall tiles are cladding pieces fixed to a facade to protect the wall and shape its look. Common choices in Pakistan are natural sandstone, clay gutka and terracotta jali. Check the wall is dry and sound, plan drainage, and judge a real sample in daylight before ordering.
ai_summary: Front elevation in Pakistan commonly uses stone feature panels, brick-look clay gutka and terracotta jali screens. The wall behind must be dry and sound, and drip edges, sills and joints matter as much as the tile. Pak Clay Tiles, making clay tiles in Lahore since 1982, offers free samples on WhatsApp.
author: Pak Clay Team

faqs.question: What tiles are best for a house front wall in Pakistan?
faqs.answer: Natural sandstone gives a rugged face, clay gutka a traditional brick look and terracotta jali a screened pattern. Choose by wall exposure, weight and fixing, and judge a sample in daylight.

faqs.question: Can I use brick cladding tiles instead of building a brick wall?
faqs.answer: Yes, brick cladding tiles are thin clay pieces fixed to a finished wall for the look with less weight. The wall behind must be dry and sound, and your mason should confirm the fixing method.

faqs.question: How much do front elevation stone and cladding tiles cost?
faqs.answer: Cost depends on material, thickness, size, quantity and delivery, and fixing and labour are separate lines. We do not quote a rate here, so ask for a dated written quote.

faqs.question: Which is better for a facade, stone or clay gutka?
faqs.answer: Neither wins everywhere. Stone is bolder and heavier; clay gutka has a traditional brick look but is porous. Compare samples against your wall, and see our outdoor wall tiles guide for more.

faqs.question: How do I order samples for my front wall?
faqs.answer: Message us on WhatsApp with your city and wall type. Pak Clay offers a free sample and a dated quote, and you can also visit the Walton Road showroom in Lahore or the Islamabad office.
